======================================================================
                  ComeFort - Quick Start Guide
======================================================================

Prerequisites:
  - Java 21 or higher installed on your computer.
    Download from https://adoptium.net if needed.

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Option 1: Just Run (No Installation Required)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- To open the Desktop GUI:
    Double-click 'ComeFort-GUI.bat'

- To use the Terminal CLI:
    Double-click 'ComeFort-CLI.bat'
    (Opens a terminal pre-configured with the 'cf' command)

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Option 2: Install System-Wide (Recommended)
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Double-click 'install.bat'.
2. It will:
   - Add ComeFort to your User PATH.
   - Create a 'ComeFort' shortcut on your Desktop.
3. You can now:
   - Double-click the Desktop shortcut anytime to open the GUI.
   - Open ANY Command Prompt or PowerShell and type:
       cf --help
       cf c "your quick thought"
       cf today
       cf gui

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Commands Cheat Sheet:
----------------------------------------------------------------------
  cf c "thought"              Quick capture to inbox
  cf inbox                    Review inbox items
  cf project add <name>       Create a project
  cf project list             List projects
  cf task add "<title>"       Add a task (-p project, -d today, --priority high)
  cf task list                List tasks (filter by project, status, priority)
  cf task done "<title|id>"   Mark task as done
  cf note add "<title>"       Create note (-c content, -p project)
  cf search "<query>"         Search across tasks, projects, notes & inbox
  cf today                    Daily dashboard overview
  cf status                   System status & recent activity log
  cf gui                      Launch the desktop GUI

======================================================================
